name: crafting

tools.name: start_project
tools.help: Start making something you'd like to exist. The plan is yours: give the steps you think it takes (the first few will do). The world checks it and tells you what you can't know yet.

goal.description: what it should be, look like or do, one sentence

materials.description: things you expect this step to use up, e.g. {"wire": 2}

tools.name: work_on
tools.help: Spend a block of focused time (15-120 minutes) on one of your projects. You'll find out how it went when the time is up. Resting stops early.

approach.description: how you'll go about it this time - the world judges what you actually try, so a thoughtful approach counts

expect.description: optional: how you expect this session to go; you'll see how close you were

tools.name: experiment
tools.help: Test an idea about one of your projects (a hypothesis) for 20-90 minutes. What you learn is the world's to decide; a good guess teaches more.

hypothesis.description: what you think might be true or work, and how you'll test it

expect.description: optional: how you expect it to turn out; you'll see how close you were

tools.name: revise_plan
tools.help: Change a project's plan: add steps, or drop ones you haven't begun. If you learned something elsewhere that might settle what you didn't know, say what in `because`.

materials.description: things you expect this step to use up, e.g. {"wire": 2}

because.description: what you learned, and from where

tools.name: abandon_project
tools.help: Give up on one of your projects (materials already used are gone).

tools.name: resume_project
tools.help: Pick a project that is on hold back up.

answers.pause: puts an active project on hold: {project}
answers.resume: picks a project on hold back up: {project}
answers.add_slot: makes room for one more project at once

reason: Crafting as a module: projects with the agent's own plans, work sessions judged by the die and the narrator, experiments, plan revisions, craft skills, and what a finished project turns out to be. Replaces the engine's own projects.
